subject: Import packages on remote machine automatically

messages.author: 84b07bd49ab2ab76
messages.subject: Import packages on remote machine automatically
parts:
Hi thx for doing that amazing work!

I just have one basic question which I cant figure out, so I apologize in advance.

Having multiple machines, I would like to have always the same set of packages installed under my R-project. My R-project is a package as well. What is the actual workflow here?

So basically after taking a snapshot with packrat, I would like to install my package on a remote machine automatically. That is done by Rscript in shell, where I reinstall the package, every time some changes happend on github. So that is a part of that:


#!/usr/bin/Rscript

new <-
  list.of.packages[(list.of.packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if (length(new.packages))
  remove.packages(new)
devtools::install_github('me/mypackage')

My question is, do I have to use:

packrat::restore()

 as well for ensuring that the same set of functions/packages is used on the remote machine?

Thank you!
